title: UGREEN USB 3.0 Switch $28.97 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ UGREEN via Amazon AU
body:
Deal: UGREEN USB 3.0 Switch $28.97 + Delivery ($0 with Prime/ $59 Spend) @ UGREEN via Amazon AU

[prelude] Lists as unavailable for me. Good price though
Edit: never mind, Amazon had set my location to Brazil for some reason lol
[asspray] what does it do, bought for plugging in usb- A into usb C port. but what else does it do?
[cloudie9] Its a KVM switch, if you run 2 sets of PC and sharing a single keyboard, mouse, printer, this is the solution.
[CaffeinatedTech] Well, KM, the V part you have to work out yourself. most monitors have at least two inputs.
[krisspy] Technically can work for any usb devices so U switch.
[sticky8anana] thanks OP, I dont have a PC but bought one anyway
[Fergy1987] Already have one. Wonder if it's worth having one as a spare at this price just in case of failure.
[ReaperX22] Does what it says on the tin.
Works well for me, plugged into the monitor for my laptop use (type c) and into my pc. I split my keyboard and audio device this way, and also power my lightbar from it.
I use different mice for work play, but you can absolutely also do the ol, hub on a hub, if you needed more devices, if they're fairly low power.
[bogak] Does the switcher need a power supply to work?
[cloudie9] Don't have too but preferably if you have spare USB-C chargers lying around or USB-C charging hub spare port.
[ReaperX22] As below, technically no but you'll have far less issues if you connect one. I've found with say audio devices or webcams they struggle to initiate sometimes without attached power.
[Chadlynx] Really useful if you have a separate work and personal set up, I have one side plugged into my laptop dock and one side into my desktop tower.
Keyboard, mouse, webcam, and audio interface into the switcher.
[krisspy] Hdmi switch or kvm?
Gets REALLY expensive when you need high refresh/resolutions at the same time
[prelude] You can find 4x2 (4 inputs, 2 outputs) matrix switches on AliExpress for <$50 if you only need HDMI / 1080p. Above that they can get very expensive
[vid_ghost] The ones that support two monitors cost a bit
[derekek] Someone share their setup for this? So you clicked a button and mouse and keyboard swapped, then click multiple button on the monitor to swap input? Sounds like just have everything on type C dock then unplug and plug is less hassle. Correct me if I’m wrong?
[vid_ghost] I just use a Logitech MK250 Compact Graphite Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo for $20 on sale for my second PC.
Its doing what this does pretty much
[ReaperX22] Type c docks usually only cater to one device. And are significantly more expensive.
My type c monitor, with laptop and like.. 3-4 usb devices, works better with this usb switch because my connections aren't really shared. DP to PC. Type c to laptop. Mice are different.
You kinda need a kvm/dock for your use case and decent ones cost a lot. So a 30 dollar usb switch does everything I need it to for my use case.
[C1de] Yes it's basically replacing plugging/unplugging with a switch. I.e need to switch between work laptop to personal/ secondary pc all the time.
[theguyisat] I have one going to my PC, and one going to my work laptop. With the 4 connections, I have my keyboard (Aula F99 Pro 2.4ghz), Logitech Powerplay mat, Logitech Brio 4k, and an Audio Technica AT2020+ connected to it.
When it's work time, I press the button on the included extended switcher and all them work seamlessly. Past 5pm, press the button again.
I haven't had to plug/unplug anything for years.
[derekek] Yeah but what about video input? You still have to switch that over in a way. Or you have two monitors always on one connected each machine?
[kochi murali] Down to $41.39 + apply the 30% off coupon, what is the 30% off coupon code please.
[hamza23] It was just a checkbox on the listing, looks like it's gone now. Marked expired.
[Munki] OMG I had it in my cart and dilly dallied too long. Didn't realise it'd expire so fast.
[hamza23] I don't think the checkbox was supposed to be there after they dropped the price from $60.
[Munki] Their discounts are always so weird it's hard to know what is intentional and what isn't. This is a slightly older model (there's a newer one) so not out of the realms of a real discount.
